description: Intellite Stack sync and instructions (SessionStart), and the Stack's changes during a conversation (UserPromptSubmit).

hooks.commandWindows: $r = if ($env:INTELLITE_SYNC_STATE) { $env:INTELLITE_SYNC_STATE } else { Join-Path $HOME '.intellite\sync' }; $j = Join-Path $r 'prompt-codex.json'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $j) { [Console]::Out.Write([IO.File]::ReadAllText($j)); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $j -Force }; $m = Join-Path $r 'prompt-codex.mark'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $m) -and ([DateTime]::UtcNow - (Get-Item -LiteralPath $m).LastWriteTimeUtc).TotalMinutes -lt 10) { exit 0 }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $r | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($m, ''); Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath powershell.exe -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', ('"' + (Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'sync\sync.ps1') + '"'), 'prompt-run', 'codex') | Out-Null
